newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin still has cold, stays at country residence.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin still has cold, stays at country residence.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin was still at his country residence outside Moscow on Wednesday nursing the cold he went down with at the start of the week, a Kremlin spokesman said.
"He is staying at Gorky-9 and keeping to the same treatment, being partially confined to bed," the spokesman told Reuters.

Chief Kremlin doctor Sergei Mironov is keeping a close eye on the 65-year-old president, who had a multiple heart bypass operation on November 5. Aides insist the cold has no connection to the surgery.
On Monday, Yeltsin cancelled engagements for a few days. He look tired and pale in television footage of his meeting with German Chancellor Helmut Kohl near Moscow on Saturday.

His chief spokesman said the president had a heavy cold. Russian media have reported that several of the president's family had fallen victim to a cold epidemic sweeping Moscow over the New Year holiday period.
Texan heart surgeon Michael DeBakey, who advised Yeltsin's doctors during the heart surgery, said on Monday the president was recovering on schedule.
